reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share significant updates to our movement mechanics in Provincia! Our latest development focuses on how ranks move and engage in battle. No more teleporting units or awkward formations. Soldiers now slide into position, maintaining their formation as they turn and march. This change enhances the realism of battles, ensuring that units behave like a cohesive group. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

discord.content: Hey everyone! We're thrilled to announce updates to the movement mechanics in Provincia. Ranks will now turn and march without teleporting, creating a more realistic and engaging battle experience. Soldiers will slide into their positions, and attacks will reform ranks rather than wheel through each other. For more details, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=discord&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
